firewalls: No family-specific exclusion implies perfect-cuboid nonexistence.
Equation (6) is not universal; no A1-5/A1-6/A1-8/A1-9 condition is promoted to arbitrary perfect cuboids.
The A1-8 Jacobian isogeny does not by itself determine C(Q).
A1-9 rank and torsion data are external LMFDB inputs and must be independently audited together with the explicit model transformations.
Eliminating the Gplus delta=+19 torsor does not eliminate Gplus or the full first-two-cover curve.
Positive rank of an elliptic twist does not imply a surviving point satisfying the extra square-coordinate condition.
The height-5000 search is finite evidence only.
Everywhere local solubility does not imply a rational point.
Stage27 and StructureRadar receivers remain unchanged.
